SWIT QB Companion 2.0.0-beta.106

Apply the credit… on a customer payment with money left as credit, for example one paid before the invoice was made. It applies the credit to the customer’s open invoices, oldest first. A payment already in QuickBooks is changed there, keeping the invoices it already has, after checking QuickBooks still has the credit unused. Until QuickBooks has it, Take the credit off undoes it.
Transactions on the customer’s page: every transaction of the customer and its jobs, read from QuickBooks, newest first. That covers invoices, payments, sales receipts, credit memos, journals and refunds, with the charge, payment and balance, plus anything not yet in QuickBooks. The period is your choice, and anything recorded in the app links to its page.
